# Final Finish Epoxy Coatings: site map

Last updated: 19 November 2026. This is a map of the public pages on https://www.finalfinishepoxy.ca/. The HTML pages are the source of truth. The short guide is https://www.finalfinishepoxy.ca/llms.txt. One-sentence summaries below are taken from the pages themselves (titles and meta descriptions, plus facts already written in /llms.txt). This file does not invent reviews, rankings, prices, or sales figures.

Prices are not published on the site. Estimates are free. Metallic epoxy and polished concrete are not listed as Final Finish services. The site uses Torginol products for the flake floors it installs; it does not say Torginol is the only product it uses.

## Main pages

- https://www.finalfinishepoxy.ca/
  Home. Torginol flake floors for Edmonton garages, homes and commercial spaces, built on proper Surface Preparation. Free estimates, up to about 145 km out.
- https://www.finalfinishepoxy.ca/about
  About. Final Finish Epoxy Coatings was founded by Denis. Flake floors and quality floor makeovers in Edmonton, Alberta. Torginol products. No showroom and no street address; the work happens at the customer's property.
- https://www.finalfinishepoxy.ca/contact
  Request a quote. Send photos for a free estimate, or book a visit. Denis looks at the concrete first.
- https://www.finalfinishepoxy.ca/services
  Six services: Residential and Commercial Floors; Surface Preparation; Concrete Repair, Levelling and Diamond Grinding; Crack Filling; Decorative Epoxy; Anti-Slip Coating.
- https://www.finalfinishepoxy.ca/services/residential-epoxy-flooring
  Residential flake floors for barns, workshops, basements, kitchens and bathrooms. Garage floors have their own page.
- https://www.finalfinishepoxy.ca/services/commercial-epoxy-flooring
  Commercial Torginol flake floors for warehouses, showrooms and industrial spaces in Edmonton and up to about 145 km out.
- https://www.finalfinishepoxy.ca/services/concrete-solutions
  Surface Preparation and concrete repair in Edmonton: grinding, filling, levelling and diamond grinding, plus Crack Filling.
- https://www.finalfinishepoxy.ca/services/garage-floor-coating-edmonton
  Garage floor coating in Edmonton. A Torginol flake floor on a prepared slab, with a free estimate from photos or a visit.
- https://www.finalfinishepoxy.ca/process
  How a flake floor is installed: estimate, grind, cosmetic crack filling, flake broadcast, scrape, and top coat.
- https://www.finalfinishepoxy.ca/projects
  Before-and-after photographs of real Final Finish work in Edmonton. The films and interiors on the site are concept visualizations.
- https://www.finalfinishepoxy.ca/finishes
  Featured Torginol flake colours. 37 colours are shown: 17 most popular first, then 20 more from the collection. Any Torginol colour, custom blends and special orders.
- https://www.finalfinishepoxy.ca/floor-visualizer
  Try the same 37 Torginol flake colours (17 most popular, plus 20 more) on a photo of your own garage or room. The preview runs on your device. Then request a free estimate.
- https://www.finalfinishepoxy.ca/warranty
  Warranty terms for preparation, the flake floor, and wear are written into the quote Denis sends you.
- https://www.finalfinishepoxy.ca/service-area
  Service area: Edmonton and Central Alberta, up to about 145 km out, including St. Albert and Athabasca.
- https://www.finalfinishepoxy.ca/resources
  Flake floor resource library for Edmonton and the surrounding area.

## Markdown mirrors

Key pages also have a `.md` file with the same facts as the HTML, linked from the page with rel=alternate. See the list in /llms.txt.
